semgrep_missing: Semgrep is not installed ({detail}). Run: jgates doctor --fix (or pip install semgrep in the project's Python environment).
semgrep_probe_failed: Semgrep at {path} did not answer --version. Reinstall with: jgates doctor --fix.
semgrep_timeout: Semgrep exceeded the limit of {seconds} s and was ended.
semgrep_invalid_output: The Semgrep output is not the expected JSON: {detail}
semgrep_no_invocation: The plan has no Semgrep invocation for the instance {tool}.
semgrep_condition_local: Uses only the binding's local rules; accesses neither a registry nor the network.
semgrep_no_binding: The instance {tool} has no local rules: declare tools.{tool}.config pointing to a rules file or folder (for example .jgates/rules).
semgrep_binding_refused: The rules binding of the instance {tool} was refused ({detail}). Fix the path in .jgates/tools.yml.
semgrep_binding_missing: The rules folder or file of the instance {tool} does not exist ({detail}). Create the rule in the tool area or fix the path.
semgrep_no_rule_files: The rules folder of the instance {tool} has no .yml or .yaml files ({detail}). Create at least one rule.
semgrep_rules_invalid: Invalid local rules in the instance {tool}: {detail}. Fix the file before planning.
semgrep_condition_prepared: Uses the registry rules {ref} prepared earlier (hash {hash}, from {source}); the local copy runs without network.
semgrep_prepared_missing: The instance {tool} pins the rules {ref} in {file}, but the prepared copy is not in the data folder. Run jgates tools prepare --instance {tool} --no-interactive.
semgrep_prepared_corrupt: The prepared copy of the rules {ref} of the instance {tool} does not match the hash in {file}. Run jgates tools prepare --instance {tool} --no-interactive.
